item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Gaurav studies the diagram of triangles $PQR$ and $XYZ$. Each angle of $PQR$ equals the matching angle of $XYZ$, but the sides of $XYZ$ are longer.

Which claim correctly decides whether the triangles are congruent?

options.A: Yes: they are the same shape, and same shape means congruent.
options.B: Yes: the matching equal angles alone settle congruence.
options.C: No: equal angles give the same shape, but different sizes mean the triangles need not be congruent.
options.D: Yes, because the printed degree marks are the standout cue in the diagram.
